title: A conversation-analytic perspective of repair initiation in ESL classroom interactions
core_idea: To investigate the nature and function of repair initiation in Ghanaian ESL classroom interactions by applying conversation-analytic methods to 52 hours of recorded classroom data, with a focus on how interlocutors initiate repair when communication troubles occur.
tldr: A conversation-analytic study examining how repair initiation is used to manage communication trouble in Ghanaian ESL classrooms through qualitative analysis of 52 hours of recordings.
